transcript_chunks.body: Why is this a per-site flag and not just on by default everywhere?

Per-site opt-in protects the assembly token budget — sites that haven't reasoned about transcript-span surfacing should not silently lose budget for the L2.5 section. The discipline is: each site decides whether the token cost is worth the deliberation context.
